description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on Motor Cars and other Vehicles
categorisation: This gazette notification contains an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, amending excise duty rates on specific goods. It establishes new regulatory requirements and tax rates, making it a legal/regulatory matter. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance"), and the primary content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
